reapers.codex: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const tool = '/Users/woogis/.claude/plugins/cache/openai-codex/codex/1.0.6/scripts/codex-companion.mjs'; const target = process.env.STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH; if (!target) { console.error('STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH is required'); process.exit(1); } const status = spawnSync(process.execPath, [tool, 'status', '--all', '--json'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (status.status !== 0) { process.stdout.write(status.stdout || ''); process.stderr.write(status.stderr || ''); process.exit(status.status || 1); } const jobs = (JSON.parse(status.stdout).running || []).filter((job) => job.request?.prompt?.includes(target)); let failed = false; for (const job of jobs) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [tool, 'cancel', job.id], { encoding: 'utf8' }); process.stdout.write(result.stdout || ''); process.stderr.write(result.stderr || ''); failed ||= result.status !== 0; } if (failed) process.exitCode = 1;"

reviewers.codex:

Read the work card at $STAGE_WORK_ITEM_PATH and the shared work log at $STAGE_WORK_LOG_PATH. Read the JSON array at $STAGE_CHANGED_PATHS_FILE; it is the driver-observed list of repository-relative paths changed by this step. Open every listed path directly from the project root. First, CRITERIA VERDICT: judge every item under the card's ## Success criteria as PASS or FAIL with a reason. Only a failed success criterion may be marked [P1]. If every criterion passes, include APPROVED. Second, OUT-OF-CRITERIA OBSERVATIONS: list any other findings separately; these observations must not be marked [P1] and must not block this card." 2>&1); STATUS=$?; printf '
### Reviewer report
%s
' "$OUT" >> "$STAGE_WORK_LOG_PATH" || { echo "BLOCK: cannot append codex review to work log"; exit 1; }; printf '%s
' "$OUT"; if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOCK: codex review command failed with exit code $STATUS"; exit 1; fi; case "$OUT" in *"[P1]"*) echo "BLOCK: codex review reported a P1 blocker"; exit 1;; *"APPROVED"*) exit 0;; *) echo "BLOCK: codex review produced no verdict"; exit 1;; esac
